name: Aurora Glass — macOS × Edge New Tab
description: A fully open-source, privacy-first new tab, home page, and AI sidebar with a macOS-vibrancy, Edge-Aurora inspired glass UI — traffic-light buttons, squircle icons, a floating dock, spring animations, and a bring-your-own-key AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Groq, Azure OpenAI, or your own local server). Everything is stored locally; nothing is ever sent anywhere except what you explicitly trigger yourself.
author: UniCone-dev
